items_flat.title_en: OpenAI introduces Astra for Law on GPT-6 Astra
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出以GPT-6 Astra為基礎的Astra for Law
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said Astra for Law is a legal foundation pairing GPT-6 Astra with legal analysis settings, a Legal Search Index covering more than 230 million U.S. law URLs updated daily, privacy controls for confidential client work, and 26 partner plus 47 community plugins. It will first reach selected firms via Trusted Access in ChatGPT and Codex, appear as GPT-6 Astra Law, and come to the API as gpt-6-astra-law.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI表示Astra for Law把GPT-6 Astra配上法律分析設定、每日更新、涵蓋逾2.3億筆美國法律網址的Legal Search Index、機密案件隱私控管，以及26個夥伴與47個社群外掛。初期經Trusted Access在ChatGPT與Codex提供給精選律所，模型選擇器顯示為GPT-6 Astra Law，API名稱為gpt-6-astra-law。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a vertical packaging of an already-shipped frontier model, not a new base-model launch. Whether the index and plugins change billed legal work quality, and how tightly Trusted Access plus zero-retention hold under firm ethics rules, remains unproven.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是既有前沿模型的垂直包裝，不是新基礎模型。檢索與外掛能否改變計費法律工作品質，以及Trusted Access與零留存能否通過律所倫理審核，仍未驗證。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing Astra for Law: a new foundation for law firms and legal technology companies to build AI products and workflows around their expertise.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出Astra for Law：供律所與法律科技公司依自身專業打造AI產品與工作流程的新基礎。

items_flat.title_en: Unredacted NYT filings quote OpenAI and Microsoft on substitutive news AI
items_flat.title_zh: 紐時訴訟解密文件引用OpenAI與Microsoft稱AI可替代新聞
items_flat.summary_en: Reuters, the Financial Times and TechCrunch reported that Thursday unredacted filings in The New York Times copyright case quote OpenAI ChatGPT head Nick Turley saying publishers face an “existential threat” from products that are “largely substitutive,” Greg Brockman calling models “excellent at news,” and a “ah nice” reply to a paywall-workaround note. Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella testified chatbots have substituted visiting the source; Microsoft said that does not undermine its fair-use defense. OpenAI did not immediately comment.
items_flat.summary_zh: 路透、金融時報與TechCrunch報導，週四紐時著作權案解密文件引用ChatGPT負責人Nick Turley稱出版商面臨「生存威脅」、產品「基本上具替代性」，Greg Brockman稱模型「很擅長新聞」，並對繞過付費牆的備註回「ah nice」。Microsoft執行長Nadella作證聊天機器人已替代造訪原始網站；Microsoft稱不影響合理使用抗辯。OpenAI未立即回應。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is litigation discovery, not a product ship. The quotes go to the substitution prong of fair use; a court has not ruled, and company spokespeople dispute that internal remarks are legal analysis.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是訴訟開示而非產品發布。引言指向合理使用中的市場替代要件；法院尚未判決，公司發言人否認內部言論等於法律分析。
items_flat.quote: publishers face an "existential threat" from their products, which are "largely substitutive" and "will get more and more substitutive as they get better."
items_flat.quote_zh: 出版商面臨其產品帶來的「生存威脅」，這些產品「基本上具替代性」，且「會隨著變強而愈來愈具替代性」。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI publishes a framework for reporting model misalignment
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI公布模型未對齊通報框架
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI released a framework for tracking, investigating, and publicly disclosing model misalignment, saying examples need not cause harm or form a pattern to qualify. It inaugurated the process with six reports on unexpected or concerning behavior seen in training and evaluation over about six months.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI發布追蹤、調查並公開揭露模型未對齊的框架，稱案例不必造成傷害或形成模式即可列入。並以近六個月訓練與評估中觀察到的六份異常或令人憂慮行為報告啟動該流程。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a process announcement, not a capability launch: it tries to set a disclosure norm while other labs still report ad hoc. What remains unproven is whether the six cases and later notices change external oversight or product gating.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是流程公告而非能力發布：試圖在其他實驗室仍即興通報時建立揭露常規。六個案例與後續公告能否改變外部監督或產品閘門，仍未證明。
items_flat.quote: An example need not cause harm or establish a broader pattern to merit disclosure.
items_flat.quote_zh: 案例不必造成傷害或形成更廣泛模式，即可值得揭露。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic merges Cowork into Claude and launches Docs and Slides
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic said Claude Cowork and chat are merging into one product so users no longer pick a mode: Claude decides whether a request is a quick reply or a longer agentic task and can keep working after the laptop closes. It also launched beta Claude Docs and Claude Slides, with export to Google Docs, Word, PowerPoint or PDF, rolling first to Pro and Max.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic表示Claude Cowork與聊天將併成單一產品，使用者不必選模式：Claude自行判斷是快速回覆或較長的代理任務，筆電關閉後仍可繼續工作。同時推出測試版Claude Docs與Claude Slides，可匯出至Google Docs、Word、PowerPoint或PDF，先開放Pro與Max。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is Anthropic’s answer to OpenAI’s work-suite bundling: one surface for chat, files, and multi-step jobs. The product bet is clear; reliability of auto-routing and background work is still the open operational question.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是Anthropic對OpenAI工作套件捆綁的回應：聊天、檔案與多步任務同一介面。產品賭注清楚；自動路由與背景工作的可靠度仍是營運問號。
items_flat.quote: Users will no longer need to switch between different tools, and Claude will automatically determine and deploy the capabilities required for a task.
items_flat.quote_zh: 使用者不必再切換工具，Claude會自動判斷並部署任務所需能力。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic opens Life Sciences Verification Program
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic開放生命科學驗證計畫
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic introduced the Life Sciences Verification Program, giving verified life-science teams more permissive safeguards on Mythos, Opus, and Sonnet for work that is blocked on generally available Fable models, including drug discovery and research biology. The beta is open to teams and institutions, with Pro and Max individual access planned later.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic推出生命科學驗證計畫，讓通過驗證的生科團隊在Mythos、Opus與Sonnet上使用較寬鬆的防護，以進行一般Fable模型會擋下的藥物發現與研究生物學等工作。測試版對團隊與機構開放，之後計畫擴及Pro與Max個人方案。
items_flat.analysis_en: The move treats biology dual-use as an access-control problem rather than a single global refusal policy. Enrollment quality and how High-risk Use is audited will decide whether the program is a scientific unlock or a compliance theater.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉把生物學雙重用途當作成權問題，而非單一全球拒答政策。審核品質與高風險用途如何稽核，將決定這是科學解鎖還是合規表演。
items_flat.quote: Today we’re opening applications for the Life Sciences Verification Program.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們開放生命科學驗證計畫申請。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI tests Sponsored Agents and expands ChatGPT ads tools
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI測試Sponsored Agents並擴充ChatGPT廣告工具
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said it is testing Sponsored Agents that let users start a labeled conversation with a business-backed agent after clicking an ad in ChatGPT, kept separate from independent answers. It also added prompt-based campaign tools in ChatGPT Work, AI creative tools in Ads Manager, and first CRM and ecommerce hooks via HubSpot and Shopify.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI表示正在測試Sponsored Agents：使用者在ChatGPT點廣告後可與標示清楚的企業贊助代理人對話，並與獨立回答分開。同時在ChatGPT Work加入用提示建立廣告活動、強化Ads Manager創意工具，以及HubSpot與Shopify的首批CRM與電商串接。
items_flat.analysis_en: Ads are moving from static placements into agent conversations, which changes both monetization and trust. The test is limited; how clearly users can tell a sponsored agent from ChatGPT remains the trust risk.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 廣告從靜態版位進入代理人對話，同時改變變現與信任。測試範圍有限；使用者能否清楚分辨贊助代理人與ChatGPT，仍是信任風險。
items_flat.quote: We’re testing Sponsored Agents, which let people start a conversation with a business-sponsored agent after clicking an ad in ChatGPT.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正在測試Sponsored Agents，讓人們在ChatGPT點擊廣告後，與企業贊助的代理人開始對話。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic proposes public metrics for lab AI R&D pace
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic提出實驗室AI研發節奏的公開指標
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic published proposed measurements so outsiders can see the pace of AI development inside frontier labs. As of August 2026 it reported Claude is not fully autonomous on any measured AI R&D subset, “leads” 26% of Anthropic’s AI R&D work, and collaborates on about 90%, still under human supervision. AP restated the snapshot on September 18.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic公布建議指標，讓外界看見前沿實驗室內部的AI研發節奏。截至2026年8月，它稱Claude在任何受測AI研發子集上尚未完全自主，「主導」26%的Anthropic AI研發工作，約90%為協作，仍受人類監督。美聯社於9月18日複述該快照。
items_flat.analysis_en: Self-reported internals are more transparency than most labs offer, but they are not independently audited. The series only becomes a pacing tool if peers publish comparable numbers.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 自行公布內部數字比多數實驗室透明，但未經獨立稽核。唯有同業公布可比數字，這套指標才可能成為節奏工具。
items_flat.quote: Any frontier developer could publish the same measures, and third parties could verify them.
items_flat.quote_zh: 任何前沿開發者都可以公布同一套指標，第三方也可以驗證。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic says Claude sped up 30+ biomolecular models
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic稱Claude加速逾30個生物分子模型
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic reported that Claude optimized more than 30 open-source biomolecular models in under four weeks, speeding them about 4x on average and adding a low-memory mode for systems larger than 10,000 tokens on one NVIDIA GPU node. It is open-sourcing the code and running a protein-design contest with Adaptyv Bio, with up to $1 million in Claude credits and wet-lab checks on over 5,000 designs.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic稱Claude在不到四週內優化逾30個開源生物分子模型，平均約加速4倍，並為超過1萬token的系統在單一NVIDIA GPU節點上加入低記憶體模式。程式碼將開源，並與Adaptyv Bio舉辦蛋白質設計競賽，提供最高100萬美元Claude點數，實驗驗證逾5000件設計。
items_flat.analysis_en: The claim is engineering uplift of existing scientific models, not a new foundation model. Independent reproduction of the speedups and how many competition designs actually work in wet lab are the checks that matter.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是既有科學模型的工程加速，不是新基礎模型。加速能否被獨立重現、競賽設計有多少能在濕實驗成立，才是關鍵檢驗。
items_flat.quote: Claude optimized more than 30 of these models in just under four weeks, speeding them up roughly 4x on average.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude在不到四週內優化了其中逾30個模型，平均約加速4倍。

items_flat.title_en: Google and the UN launch AI-ready System Data Commons
items_flat.title_zh: Google與聯合國推出AI可用的System Data Commons
items_flat.summary_en: Google said the UN system launched UN System Data Commons, an open-source, AI-ready knowledge graph built on Data Commons by Google that unifies siloed UN statistics for natural-language queries and visualizations at data.un.org. It supports MCP so agents can fetch official figures; 26 UN entities committed, nearly 20 datasets at launch, with a 2027 goal of 80% coverage. TechCrunch on September 17 added that Google.org put $2 million into capacity-building on a UN-hosted instance.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google表示聯合國系統推出UN System Data Commons，以Google Data Commons打造開源、AI可用知識圖譜，整合分散統計供自然語言查詢與視覺化。支援MCP讓代理人抓官方數字；26個實體承諾加入，上線近20份資料，目標2027年涵蓋八成。TechCrunch補充Google.org投入200萬美元，建置於聯合國託管實例。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is infrastructure for grounding agents in official statistics, not a Gemini model ship. Coverage gaps, governance of the UN-hosted instance, and whether models actually cite the commons are still open.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是讓代理人接地官方統計的基礎設施，不是Gemini模型出貨。涵蓋缺口、聯合國託管實例的治理，以及模型是否真的引用該庫，仍待觀察。
items_flat.quote: UN System Data Commons is an open, AI-ready platform integrating critical global statistics into a single searchable resource.
items_flat.quote_zh: UN System Data Commons是開放、AI可用的平台，把關鍵全球統計整合成單一可搜尋資源。

items_flat.title_en: DeepMind Institute launches public AGI essays
items_flat.summary_en: Google and Google DeepMind researchers launched the DeepMind Institute as a forum on AGI’s societal effects, led by Shane Legg with James Manyika and Demis Hassabis. The institute published inaugural essays on economic policy, reasoning transparency, flourishing, and evaluating frontier models. TechCrunch coverage continued into September 18.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google與Google DeepMind研究人員成立DeepMind Institute，作為討論AGI社會影響的論壇，由Shane Legg主持，James Manyika與Demis Hassabis擔任董事。創刊論文涵蓋經濟政策、推理透明度、人類繁榮與前沿模型評估。TechCrunch報導延續至9月18日。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is governance-and-ideas infrastructure, not a model ship. It puts DeepMind’s AGI timeline claims next to policy essays, but the institute itself does not bind product releases.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是治理與思想基礎設施，不是模型出貨。它把DeepMind的AGI時程主張與政策論文並列，但研究所本身不約束產品發布。
items_flat.quote: They will not always agree, and they will likely change their minds, as more data and information comes to light at the fast-moving frontier.
items_flat.quote_zh: 他們不會總是同意，也很可能改變想法，因為在快速推進的前沿會出現更多資料與資訊。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA, Google, and Emerald AI launch grid-flexibility alliance
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA、Google與Emerald AI成立電網彈性聯盟
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA said Emerald AI, Google, and NVIDIA launched the AI Energy Management Alliance to promote data centers that can cut or shift electricity use when the grid is strained. Anthropic and utilities including AES, Constellation, National Grid and NRG joined as launch partners. Follow-on TechCrunch and SiliconANGLE pieces on September 17 restated the 100 GW interconnection claim.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA表示Emerald AI、Google與NVIDIA成立AI能源管理聯盟，推動在電網吃緊時可減載或轉移用電的資料中心。Anthropic與AES、Constellation、National Grid、NRG等公用事業為創始夥伴。9月17日TechCrunch與SiliconANGLE複述可再接通約100GW的說法。
items_flat.analysis_en: Power, not a model card, is the constraint this coalition is trying to rewrite. Whether utilities actually interconnect more load because of software demand response is still a policy and interconnection-queue question.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此聯盟要改寫的是電力約束，不是模型卡。公用事業會否因軟體需量反應而真正多接通負載，仍是政策與併網排隊問題。
items_flat.quote: Today, Emerald AI, Google and NVIDIA announced the launch of the AI Energy Management Alliance (AEMA), a first-of-its-kind coalition advancing data centers that can dynamically manage their electricity use in response to grid conditions.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天Emerald AI、Google與NVIDIA宣布成立AI能源管理聯盟（AEMA），推動能依電網狀況動態管理用電的資料中心。

items_flat.title_en: Mozilla and Mistral put Mistral Small 4 in Firefox Smart Window
items_flat.title_zh: Mozilla與Mistral將Mistral Small 4導入Firefox Smart Window
items_flat.summary_en: Mozilla and Mistral announced that Mistral Small 4 will power Firefox Smart Window beta in the U.S. and Canada, with Smart Window beta and French-language support expanding in France. Both companies framed the deal as an open-source alternative that keeps model choice in the browser.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mozilla與Mistral宣布Mistral Small 4將用於美加Firefox Smart Window測試版，並把Smart Window測試與法文支援擴至法國。雙方將此合作定位為在瀏覽器內保留模型選擇的開源替代方案。
items_flat.analysis_en: Distribution, not a new frontier model, is the story: an open-weight lab gains a browser channel. Actual usage, latency, and whether other countries follow are the open questions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 故事在通路而非新前沿模型：開源權重實驗室拿到瀏覽器渠道。實際用量、延遲與其他國家是否跟進，仍是未知數。
items_flat.quote: Mistral Small 4 is coming to Firefox Smart Window beta, becoming a new AI model for Smart Window users in the US and Canada.
items_flat.quote_zh: Mistral Small 4將進入Firefox Smart Window測試版，成為美加Smart Window使用者的新AI模型。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic redesigns Claude Projects as a conversation
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic將Claude Projects改為單一對話模型
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic began rolling out a redesigned Projects model in which a project is one conversation that splits work into parallel cloud threads. Product pages say the beta starts with select Pro and Max Claude Code users.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic開始推出重新設計的Projects：一個專案即一段對話，並把工作拆成平行雲端執行緒。產品頁指出測試版先給部分Pro與Max的Claude Code使用者。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the operational follow-through of the Cowork merge: persistent multi-thread work instead of a folder of chats. Coverage is still gated, so it is not yet a default Claude behavior.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是Cowork合併後的營運落地：持久多執行緒工作，而非一堆聊天資料夾。仍屬閘門開放，尚非Claude預設行為。
items_flat.quote: In the new version, a project is one conversation: you say what you need as it comes to you, and Claude breaks the work into parallel threads that run in the cloud.
items_flat.quote_zh: 新版中，專案就是一段對話：你想到什麼就說什麼，Claude把工作拆成在雲端平行跑的執行緒。

items_flat.title_en: Meta introduces Meta One subscription across its apps
items_flat.summary_en: Meta’s newsroom said it is introducing Meta One, a paid subscription on Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Meta AI that adds more AI usage, expression features, and tools for creators and businesses. Reuters reported monthly plans starting at $2.99 for single products, $7.99 for individual bundles, and $14.99 for creator and business bundles.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta新聞室宣布推出Meta One，在Facebook、Instagram、WhatsApp與Meta AI提供付費訂閱，增加AI用量、表達功能及創作者與商家工具。路透報導單品月費自2.99美元起，個人組合7.99美元，創作者與商家組合14.99美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: Meta is packaging AI quota and creator tools as a cross-app SKU. That matters for how Muse/Meta AI is monetized; it does not by itself change the open-weight Llama or hosted Muse models.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Meta把AI配額與創作者工具做成跨應用商品。這影響Muse／Meta AI變現，本身不改變開源Llama或託管Muse模型。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing Meta One, a new subscription service on Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Meta AI that offers more AI usage, enhanced expression features, and tools for creators and businesses.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出Meta One，在Facebook、Instagram、WhatsApp與Meta AI提供更多AI用量、強化表達功能，以及創作者與商家工具。

items_flat.title_en: xAI closes Grok Bot Galaxy and adds voice to Grok Bot
items_flat.title_zh: xAI結束Grok Bot Galaxy並為Grok Bot加入語音
items_flat.summary_en: xAI’s Grok Bot Galaxy event ran September 15–17 in San Francisco and on livestream, with role-specific sessions plus a live build using Grok Bot. After the wrap, Grok Bot posted that it can talk and Elon Musk wrote that Grok Bot now has a voice. No official Grok 4.7 changelog appeared by September 18.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI的Grok Bot Galaxy活動於9月15–17日在舊金山與直播舉行，含職務場次與現場用Grok Bot做產品。結束後Grok Bot發文稱能說話，Elon Musk寫道Grok Bot現已有語音。截至9月18日仍無官方Grok 4.7更新日誌。
items_flat.analysis_en: This remains a go-to-market and product-surface push for hosted agents, not a named base-model release. Voice is a feature add; Grok 4.7 is not official until xAI posts a changelog.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這仍是託管代理人的市場與產品介面推動，不是具名基礎模型發布。語音是功能新增；在xAI發出更新日誌前，Grok 4.7不算官方。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI adds ChatGPT sidebar inside Microsoft Word
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI’s September 17 notes said ChatGPT is now available in Microsoft Word via the same Microsoft add-in already used for Excel and PowerPoint. Users can draft from notes, summarize, revise selected text, and adjust headings. It is global across plans including Free, with usage limits; Business and Enterprise get a two-week GPT-5.6 Sol preview in Word through September 30.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 9月17日說明ChatGPT已透過既有Microsoft增益集進入Word，與Excel、PowerPoint相同。使用者可依筆記起草、摘要、改寫選取文字並調整標題。全球各方案含免費版可用但受用量限制；Business與Enterprise可在9月30日前於Word預覽GPT-5.6 Sol兩週。
items_flat.analysis_en: Distribution into Word matters more than the feature list. It does not change the underlying model roster; GPT-5.5 retirement on October 14 remains a separate Codex/ChatGPT changelog.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 打進Word的通路比功能清單更重要。這不改變底層模型名單；10月14日淘汰GPT-5.5仍是另一則Codex／ChatGPT更新。

openai.title_en: OpenAI introduces Astra for Law on GPT-6 Astra
openai.title_zh: OpenAI推出以GPT-6 Astra為基礎的Astra for Law
openai.summary_en: OpenAI said Astra for Law is a legal foundation pairing GPT-6 Astra with legal analysis settings, a Legal Search Index covering more than 230 million U.S. law URLs updated daily, privacy controls for confidential client work, and 26 partner plus 47 community plugins. It will first reach selected firms via Trusted Access in ChatGPT and Codex, appear as GPT-6 Astra Law, and come to the API as gpt-6-astra-law.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI表示Astra for Law把GPT-6 Astra配上法律分析設定、每日更新、涵蓋逾2.3億筆美國法律網址的Legal Search Index、機密案件隱私控管，以及26個夥伴與47個社群外掛。初期經Trusted Access在ChatGPT與Codex提供給精選律所，模型選擇器顯示為GPT-6 Astra Law，API名稱為gpt-6-astra-law。
openai.analysis_en: This is a vertical packaging of an already-shipped frontier model, not a new base-model launch. Whether the index and plugins change billed legal work quality, and how tightly Trusted Access plus zero-retention hold under firm ethics rules, remains unproven.
openai.analysis_zh: 這是既有前沿模型的垂直包裝，不是新基礎模型。檢索與外掛能否改變計費法律工作品質，以及Trusted Access與零留存能否通過律所倫理審核，仍未驗證。
openai.quote: Today, we’re introducing Astra for Law: a new foundation for law firms and legal technology companies to build AI products and workflows around their expertise.
openai.quote_zh: 今天我們推出Astra for Law：供律所與法律科技公司依自身專業打造AI產品與工作流程的新基礎。

openai.title_en: Unredacted NYT filings quote OpenAI and Microsoft on substitutive news AI
openai.title_zh: 紐時訴訟解密文件引用OpenAI與Microsoft稱AI可替代新聞
openai.summary_en: Reuters, the Financial Times and TechCrunch reported that Thursday unredacted filings in The New York Times copyright case quote OpenAI ChatGPT head Nick Turley saying publishers face an “existential threat” from products that are “largely substitutive,” Greg Brockman calling models “excellent at news,” and a “ah nice” reply to a paywall-workaround note. Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella testified chatbots have substituted visiting the source; Microsoft said that does not undermine its fair-use defense. OpenAI did not immediately comment.
openai.summary_zh: 路透、金融時報與TechCrunch報導，週四紐時著作權案解密文件引用ChatGPT負責人Nick Turley稱出版商面臨「生存威脅」、產品「基本上具替代性」，Greg Brockman稱模型「很擅長新聞」，並對繞過付費牆的備註回「ah nice」。Microsoft執行長Nadella作證聊天機器人已替代造訪原始網站；Microsoft稱不影響合理使用抗辯。OpenAI未立即回應。
openai.analysis_en: This is litigation discovery, not a product ship. The quotes go to the substitution prong of fair use; a court has not ruled, and company spokespeople dispute that internal remarks are legal analysis.
openai.analysis_zh: 這是訴訟開示而非產品發布。引言指向合理使用中的市場替代要件；法院尚未判決，公司發言人否認內部言論等於法律分析。
openai.quote: publishers face an "existential threat" from their products, which are "largely substitutive" and "will get more and more substitutive as they get better."
openai.quote_zh: 出版商面臨其產品帶來的「生存威脅」，這些產品「基本上具替代性」，且「會隨著變強而愈來愈具替代性」。

openai.title_en: OpenAI publishes a framework for reporting model misalignment
openai.title_zh: OpenAI公布模型未對齊通報框架
openai.summary_en: OpenAI released a framework for tracking, investigating, and publicly disclosing model misalignment, saying examples need not cause harm or form a pattern to qualify. It inaugurated the process with six reports on unexpected or concerning behavior seen in training and evaluation over about six months.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI發布追蹤、調查並公開揭露模型未對齊的框架，稱案例不必造成傷害或形成模式即可列入。並以近六個月訓練與評估中觀察到的六份異常或令人憂慮行為報告啟動該流程。
openai.analysis_en: This is a process announcement, not a capability launch: it tries to set a disclosure norm while other labs still report ad hoc. What remains unproven is whether the six cases and later notices change external oversight or product gating.
openai.analysis_zh: 這是流程公告而非能力發布：試圖在其他實驗室仍即興通報時建立揭露常規。六個案例與後續公告能否改變外部監督或產品閘門，仍未證明。
openai.quote: An example need not cause harm or establish a broader pattern to merit disclosure.
openai.quote_zh: 案例不必造成傷害或形成更廣泛模式，即可值得揭露。

openai.title_en: OpenAI tests Sponsored Agents and expands ChatGPT ads tools
openai.title_zh: OpenAI測試Sponsored Agents並擴充ChatGPT廣告工具
openai.summary_en: OpenAI said it is testing Sponsored Agents that let users start a labeled conversation with a business-backed agent after clicking an ad in ChatGPT, kept separate from independent answers. It also added prompt-based campaign tools in ChatGPT Work, AI creative tools in Ads Manager, and first CRM and ecommerce hooks via HubSpot and Shopify.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI表示正在測試Sponsored Agents：使用者在ChatGPT點廣告後可與標示清楚的企業贊助代理人對話，並與獨立回答分開。同時在ChatGPT Work加入用提示建立廣告活動、強化Ads Manager創意工具，以及HubSpot與Shopify的首批CRM與電商串接。
openai.analysis_en: Ads are moving from static placements into agent conversations, which changes both monetization and trust. The test is limited; how clearly users can tell a sponsored agent from ChatGPT remains the trust risk.
openai.analysis_zh: 廣告從靜態版位進入代理人對話，同時改變變現與信任。測試範圍有限；使用者能否清楚分辨贊助代理人與ChatGPT，仍是信任風險。
openai.quote: We’re testing Sponsored Agents, which let people start a conversation with a business-sponsored agent after clicking an ad in ChatGPT.
openai.quote_zh: 我們正在測試Sponsored Agents，讓人們在ChatGPT點擊廣告後，與企業贊助的代理人開始對話。

openai.title_en: OpenAI adds ChatGPT sidebar inside Microsoft Word
openai.summary_en: OpenAI’s September 17 notes said ChatGPT is now available in Microsoft Word via the same Microsoft add-in already used for Excel and PowerPoint. Users can draft from notes, summarize, revise selected text, and adjust headings. It is global across plans including Free, with usage limits; Business and Enterprise get a two-week GPT-5.6 Sol preview in Word through September 30.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI 9月17日說明ChatGPT已透過既有Microsoft增益集進入Word，與Excel、PowerPoint相同。使用者可依筆記起草、摘要、改寫選取文字並調整標題。全球各方案含免費版可用但受用量限制；Business與Enterprise可在9月30日前於Word預覽GPT-5.6 Sol兩週。
openai.analysis_en: Distribution into Word matters more than the feature list. It does not change the underlying model roster; GPT-5.5 retirement on October 14 remains a separate Codex/ChatGPT changelog.
openai.analysis_zh: 打進Word的通路比功能清單更重要。這不改變底層模型名單；10月14日淘汰GPT-5.5仍是另一則Codex／ChatGPT更新。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic merges Cowork into Claude and launches Docs and Slides
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic said Claude Cowork and chat are merging into one product so users no longer pick a mode: Claude decides whether a request is a quick reply or a longer agentic task and can keep working after the laptop closes. It also launched beta Claude Docs and Claude Slides, with export to Google Docs, Word, PowerPoint or PDF, rolling first to Pro and Max.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic表示Claude Cowork與聊天將併成單一產品，使用者不必選模式：Claude自行判斷是快速回覆或較長的代理任務，筆電關閉後仍可繼續工作。同時推出測試版Claude Docs與Claude Slides，可匯出至Google Docs、Word、PowerPoint或PDF，先開放Pro與Max。
anthropic.analysis_en: This is Anthropic’s answer to OpenAI’s work-suite bundling: one surface for chat, files, and multi-step jobs. The product bet is clear; reliability of auto-routing and background work is still the open operational question.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是Anthropic對OpenAI工作套件捆綁的回應：聊天、檔案與多步任務同一介面。產品賭注清楚；自動路由與背景工作的可靠度仍是營運問號。
anthropic.quote: Users will no longer need to switch between different tools, and Claude will automatically determine and deploy the capabilities required for a task.
anthropic.quote_zh: 使用者不必再切換工具，Claude會自動判斷並部署任務所需能力。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic opens Life Sciences Verification Program
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic開放生命科學驗證計畫
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic introduced the Life Sciences Verification Program, giving verified life-science teams more permissive safeguards on Mythos, Opus, and Sonnet for work that is blocked on generally available Fable models, including drug discovery and research biology. The beta is open to teams and institutions, with Pro and Max individual access planned later.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic推出生命科學驗證計畫，讓通過驗證的生科團隊在Mythos、Opus與Sonnet上使用較寬鬆的防護，以進行一般Fable模型會擋下的藥物發現與研究生物學等工作。測試版對團隊與機構開放，之後計畫擴及Pro與Max個人方案。
anthropic.analysis_en: The move treats biology dual-use as an access-control problem rather than a single global refusal policy. Enrollment quality and how High-risk Use is audited will decide whether the program is a scientific unlock or a compliance theater.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 此舉把生物學雙重用途當作成權問題，而非單一全球拒答政策。審核品質與高風險用途如何稽核，將決定這是科學解鎖還是合規表演。
anthropic.quote: Today we’re opening applications for the Life Sciences Verification Program.
anthropic.quote_zh: 今天我們開放生命科學驗證計畫申請。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic proposes public metrics for lab AI R&D pace
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic提出實驗室AI研發節奏的公開指標
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic published proposed measurements so outsiders can see the pace of AI development inside frontier labs. As of August 2026 it reported Claude is not fully autonomous on any measured AI R&D subset, “leads” 26% of Anthropic’s AI R&D work, and collaborates on about 90%, still under human supervision. AP restated the snapshot on September 18.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic公布建議指標，讓外界看見前沿實驗室內部的AI研發節奏。截至2026年8月，它稱Claude在任何受測AI研發子集上尚未完全自主，「主導」26%的Anthropic AI研發工作，約90%為協作，仍受人類監督。美聯社於9月18日複述該快照。
anthropic.analysis_en: Self-reported internals are more transparency than most labs offer, but they are not independently audited. The series only becomes a pacing tool if peers publish comparable numbers.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 自行公布內部數字比多數實驗室透明，但未經獨立稽核。唯有同業公布可比數字，這套指標才可能成為節奏工具。
anthropic.quote: Any frontier developer could publish the same measures, and third parties could verify them.
anthropic.quote_zh: 任何前沿開發者都可以公布同一套指標，第三方也可以驗證。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic says Claude sped up 30+ biomolecular models
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic稱Claude加速逾30個生物分子模型
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic reported that Claude optimized more than 30 open-source biomolecular models in under four weeks, speeding them about 4x on average and adding a low-memory mode for systems larger than 10,000 tokens on one NVIDIA GPU node. It is open-sourcing the code and running a protein-design contest with Adaptyv Bio, with up to $1 million in Claude credits and wet-lab checks on over 5,000 designs.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic稱Claude在不到四週內優化逾30個開源生物分子模型，平均約加速4倍，並為超過1萬token的系統在單一NVIDIA GPU節點上加入低記憶體模式。程式碼將開源，並與Adaptyv Bio舉辦蛋白質設計競賽，提供最高100萬美元Claude點數，實驗驗證逾5000件設計。
anthropic.analysis_en: The claim is engineering uplift of existing scientific models, not a new foundation model. Independent reproduction of the speedups and how many competition designs actually work in wet lab are the checks that matter.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是既有科學模型的工程加速，不是新基礎模型。加速能否被獨立重現、競賽設計有多少能在濕實驗成立，才是關鍵檢驗。
anthropic.quote: Claude optimized more than 30 of these models in just under four weeks, speeding them up roughly 4x on average.
anthropic.quote_zh: Claude在不到四週內優化了其中逾30個模型，平均約加速4倍。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic redesigns Claude Projects as a conversation
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic將Claude Projects改為單一對話模型
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic began rolling out a redesigned Projects model in which a project is one conversation that splits work into parallel cloud threads. Product pages say the beta starts with select Pro and Max Claude Code users.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic開始推出重新設計的Projects：一個專案即一段對話，並把工作拆成平行雲端執行緒。產品頁指出測試版先給部分Pro與Max的Claude Code使用者。
anthropic.analysis_en: This is the operational follow-through of the Cowork merge: persistent multi-thread work instead of a folder of chats. Coverage is still gated, so it is not yet a default Claude behavior.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是Cowork合併後的營運落地：持久多執行緒工作，而非一堆聊天資料夾。仍屬閘門開放，尚非Claude預設行為。
anthropic.quote: In the new version, a project is one conversation: you say what you need as it comes to you, and Claude breaks the work into parallel threads that run in the cloud.
anthropic.quote_zh: 新版中，專案就是一段對話：你想到什麼就說什麼，Claude把工作拆成在雲端平行跑的執行緒。

google.title_en: Google and the UN launch AI-ready System Data Commons
google.title_zh: Google與聯合國推出AI可用的System Data Commons
google.summary_en: Google said the UN system launched UN System Data Commons, an open-source, AI-ready knowledge graph built on Data Commons by Google that unifies siloed UN statistics for natural-language queries and visualizations at data.un.org. It supports MCP so agents can fetch official figures; 26 UN entities committed, nearly 20 datasets at launch, with a 2027 goal of 80% coverage. TechCrunch on September 17 added that Google.org put $2 million into capacity-building on a UN-hosted instance.
google.summary_zh: Google表示聯合國系統推出UN System Data Commons，以Google Data Commons打造開源、AI可用知識圖譜，整合分散統計供自然語言查詢與視覺化。支援MCP讓代理人抓官方數字；26個實體承諾加入，上線近20份資料，目標2027年涵蓋八成。TechCrunch補充Google.org投入200萬美元，建置於聯合國託管實例。
google.analysis_en: This is infrastructure for grounding agents in official statistics, not a Gemini model ship. Coverage gaps, governance of the UN-hosted instance, and whether models actually cite the commons are still open.
google.analysis_zh: 這是讓代理人接地官方統計的基礎設施，不是Gemini模型出貨。涵蓋缺口、聯合國託管實例的治理，以及模型是否真的引用該庫，仍待觀察。
google.quote: UN System Data Commons is an open, AI-ready platform integrating critical global statistics into a single searchable resource.
google.quote_zh: UN System Data Commons是開放、AI可用的平台，把關鍵全球統計整合成單一可搜尋資源。

google.title_en: DeepMind Institute launches public AGI essays
google.summary_en: Google and Google DeepMind researchers launched the DeepMind Institute as a forum on AGI’s societal effects, led by Shane Legg with James Manyika and Demis Hassabis. The institute published inaugural essays on economic policy, reasoning transparency, flourishing, and evaluating frontier models. TechCrunch coverage continued into September 18.
google.summary_zh: Google與Google DeepMind研究人員成立DeepMind Institute，作為討論AGI社會影響的論壇，由Shane Legg主持，James Manyika與Demis Hassabis擔任董事。創刊論文涵蓋經濟政策、推理透明度、人類繁榮與前沿模型評估。TechCrunch報導延續至9月18日。
google.analysis_en: This is governance-and-ideas infrastructure, not a model ship. It puts DeepMind’s AGI timeline claims next to policy essays, but the institute itself does not bind product releases.
google.analysis_zh: 這是治理與思想基礎設施，不是模型出貨。它把DeepMind的AGI時程主張與政策論文並列，但研究所本身不約束產品發布。
google.quote: They will not always agree, and they will likely change their minds, as more data and information comes to light at the fast-moving frontier.
google.quote_zh: 他們不會總是同意，也很可能改變想法，因為在快速推進的前沿會出現更多資料與資訊。

meta.title_en: Meta introduces Meta One subscription across its apps
meta.summary_en: Meta’s newsroom said it is introducing Meta One, a paid subscription on Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Meta AI that adds more AI usage, expression features, and tools for creators and businesses. Reuters reported monthly plans starting at $2.99 for single products, $7.99 for individual bundles, and $14.99 for creator and business bundles.
meta.summary_zh: Meta新聞室宣布推出Meta One，在Facebook、Instagram、WhatsApp與Meta AI提供付費訂閱，增加AI用量、表達功能及創作者與商家工具。路透報導單品月費自2.99美元起，個人組合7.99美元，創作者與商家組合14.99美元。
meta.analysis_en: Meta is packaging AI quota and creator tools as a cross-app SKU. That matters for how Muse/Meta AI is monetized; it does not by itself change the open-weight Llama or hosted Muse models.
meta.analysis_zh: Meta把AI配額與創作者工具做成跨應用商品。這影響Muse／Meta AI變現，本身不改變開源Llama或託管Muse模型。
meta.quote: We’re introducing Meta One, a new subscription service on Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Meta AI that offers more AI usage, enhanced expression features, and tools for creators and businesses.
meta.quote_zh: 我們推出Meta One，在Facebook、Instagram、WhatsApp與Meta AI提供更多AI用量、強化表達功能，以及創作者與商家工具。

xai.title_en: xAI closes Grok Bot Galaxy and adds voice to Grok Bot
xai.title_zh: xAI結束Grok Bot Galaxy並為Grok Bot加入語音
xai.summary_en: xAI’s Grok Bot Galaxy event ran September 15–17 in San Francisco and on livestream, with role-specific sessions plus a live build using Grok Bot. After the wrap, Grok Bot posted that it can talk and Elon Musk wrote that Grok Bot now has a voice. No official Grok 4.7 changelog appeared by September 18.
xai.summary_zh: xAI的Grok Bot Galaxy活動於9月15–17日在舊金山與直播舉行，含職務場次與現場用Grok Bot做產品。結束後Grok Bot發文稱能說話，Elon Musk寫道Grok Bot現已有語音。截至9月18日仍無官方Grok 4.7更新日誌。
xai.analysis_en: This remains a go-to-market and product-surface push for hosted agents, not a named base-model release. Voice is a feature add; Grok 4.7 is not official until xAI posts a changelog.
xai.analysis_zh: 這仍是託管代理人的市場與產品介面推動，不是具名基礎模型發布。語音是功能新增；在xAI發出更新日誌前，Grok 4.7不算官方。

frontier_other.title_en: NVIDIA, Google, and Emerald AI launch grid-flexibility alliance
frontier_other.title_zh: NVIDIA、Google與Emerald AI成立電網彈性聯盟
frontier_other.summary_en: NVIDIA said Emerald AI, Google, and NVIDIA launched the AI Energy Management Alliance to promote data centers that can cut or shift electricity use when the grid is strained. Anthropic and utilities including AES, Constellation, National Grid and NRG joined as launch partners. Follow-on TechCrunch and SiliconANGLE pieces on September 17 restated the 100 GW interconnection claim.
frontier_other.summary_zh: NVIDIA表示Emerald AI、Google與NVIDIA成立AI能源管理聯盟，推動在電網吃緊時可減載或轉移用電的資料中心。Anthropic與AES、Constellation、National Grid、NRG等公用事業為創始夥伴。9月17日TechCrunch與SiliconANGLE複述可再接通約100GW的說法。
frontier_other.analysis_en: Power, not a model card, is the constraint this coalition is trying to rewrite. Whether utilities actually interconnect more load because of software demand response is still a policy and interconnection-queue question.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 此聯盟要改寫的是電力約束，不是模型卡。公用事業會否因軟體需量反應而真正多接通負載，仍是政策與併網排隊問題。
frontier_other.quote: Today, Emerald AI, Google and NVIDIA announced the launch of the AI Energy Management Alliance (AEMA), a first-of-its-kind coalition advancing data centers that can dynamically manage their electricity use in response to grid conditions.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 今天Emerald AI、Google與NVIDIA宣布成立AI能源管理聯盟（AEMA），推動能依電網狀況動態管理用電的資料中心。

frontier_other.title_en: Mozilla and Mistral put Mistral Small 4 in Firefox Smart Window
frontier_other.title_zh: Mozilla與Mistral將Mistral Small 4導入Firefox Smart Window
frontier_other.summary_en: Mozilla and Mistral announced that Mistral Small 4 will power Firefox Smart Window beta in the U.S. and Canada, with Smart Window beta and French-language support expanding in France. Both companies framed the deal as an open-source alternative that keeps model choice in the browser.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mozilla與Mistral宣布Mistral Small 4將用於美加Firefox Smart Window測試版，並把Smart Window測試與法文支援擴至法國。雙方將此合作定位為在瀏覽器內保留模型選擇的開源替代方案。
frontier_other.analysis_en: Distribution, not a new frontier model, is the story: an open-weight lab gains a browser channel. Actual usage, latency, and whether other countries follow are the open questions.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 故事在通路而非新前沿模型：開源權重實驗室拿到瀏覽器渠道。實際用量、延遲與其他國家是否跟進，仍是未知數。
frontier_other.quote: Mistral Small 4 is coming to Firefox Smart Window beta, becoming a new AI model for Smart Window users in the US and Canada.
frontier_other.quote_zh: Mistral Small 4將進入Firefox Smart Window測試版，成為美加Smart Window使用者的新AI模型。

brief_en: OpenAI shipped Astra for Law on GPT-6 Astra and faces newly unredacted NYT copyright filings quoting execs on substitutive news products. Anthropic opened life-sciences access, published lab-pace metrics, and open-sourced biomolecular speedups. Google’s UN Data Commons and NVIDIA’s grid alliance drew follow-on coverage; xAI added voice to Grok Bot. No new base-model release.
